## Description of Changes
Please include a summary of the changes and the motivation/context behind them.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Optimization or algorithm refinement

## Verification & Testing
- [ ] Backend test suite passes (`python -m pytest -o pythonpath=backend backend/tests`)
- [ ] Frontend builds cleanly with zero TypeScript errors (`npm run build`)
- [ ] Verified locally in browser
- [ ] Mathematical conservation laws verified (e.g., energy weights sum to 1.0, non-negative capex)

## Security & Secrets
- [ ] Verified that no credentials, `.env` files, or API keys are committed.
